zh-CN.name: 可供性与意符
zh-CN.description: 操作可能性与可感知的提示需要配合：按钮外观、标签与状态应帮助用户理解下一步。
use_when: 用于解释或比较与当前任务相关的设计选择。
avoid_when: 不要将演示参数当作通用行业标准。
zh-CN.prompt_template: 为主要操作提供明确的按钮外观与动词标签，让可交互区域有足够尺寸，并保持默认、悬停、焦点、禁用状态一致。

en.name: Affordance and Signifiers
en.description: Available actions need perceivable cues: appearance, labels, and states should make the next step understandable.
use_when: Use to explain or compare design choices relevant to the current task.
avoid_when: Do not treat demo parameters as universal standards.
en.prompt_template: Give primary actions a recognizable button shape and verb label. Use adequately sized targets and consistent default, hover, focus, and disabled states.
